Centered composition: the character with its props fills about 78% of the image height, both feet fully visible near the bottom, nothing cut off by the image edges, empty space on every side. Any placards, signs, screens, books, cards or speech bubbles are blank or show only simple pictogram icons; no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no frame, no border. No ground, no floor, no cast shadow, no scenery. Solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling everything around the subject; the subject itself must not use any magenta or hot-pink #FF00FF color.
